notes: Real user-selected pilot: Espressif ESP32-S3-EYE v2.2. Review proposal only. Main board and LCD sub-board form the assembly. Main-board schematic title is Rev 2.2, 2021-12-07. Sub-board source filename V1.1 conflicts with the Rev 1.0 title blocks and has not been resolved. Nearly all module GPIOs already serve onboard functions; do not treat the board as a generic free-GPIO module. Main-board J8/J9 pin numbers refer to the main-board schematic, not the sub-board connector reference numbers. The 20 recorded contacts are only a partial inventory. Nominal rail labels are not absolute electrical limits. Drawing width 30.00 mm and length 60.00 mm apply to the main-board outline, not a qualified assembled enclosure envelope. Public document retrieval does not grant redistribution, asset reuse, electrical approval or firmware execution. DigiKey direct retrieval was unavailable; no live quote or guaranteed stocked hardware revision is claimed. Source audit 02 adds USB, SD, camera, module pads, battery contacts, drawing-only pads and sub-board contacts. Sub-board pin-name/reservation observations remain conflicting because document identity is unresolved. Main-board back drawing confirms the 30 x 60 mm outline; sub-board drawing labels 30 x 31.90 mm, not stack height. Board assemblies, electrical ratings and asset reuse remain unqualified. ESP32-S3-EYE BSP 6.0.0 is pinned to an upstream commit as a reference; SDK/toolchain and runtime behavior are not verified.
